title: Usage
body: Algobank has no network access and writes no files. It reads only the wheels you give it. Your package manager downloads them.

# INSTALL
pip install algobank                     # standard library only, no dependencies

# DOWNLOAD (pip has the network, algobank does not)
pip download --only-binary :all: -d wheels/ requests==2.34.2    # the package and every package it calls
                                         # --only-binary: never run an sdist's build code

# CHECK EVERY FILE
algobank scope wheels/*.whl              # one report per file; called packages missing from wheels/ get a warning

# INSTALL EXACTLY WHAT WAS CHECKED
pip install --no-index --find-links wheels/ requests==2.34.2

# COMPARE TWO VERSIONS
pip download --no-deps --only-binary :all: -d wheels/ requests==2.31.0
pip download --no-deps --only-binary :all: -d wheels/ requests==2.32.3
algobank diff wheels/requests-2.31.0-py3-none-any.whl wheels/requests-2.32.3-py3-none-any.whl

requests-2.31.0-py3-none-any.whl -> requests-2.32.3-py3-none-any.whl
  nodes (functions, classes, module values): 650 (441 unchanged, 26 code changed, 170 affected by a changed dependency, 13 added, 1 removed)
  scope: TOP, env, file, network -> TOP, env, file, network
findings:
  [high] new: requests 2.32.3: PYSEC-2026-1872 (algobank/known.json)
  [high] new: requests 2.32.3: PYSEC-2026-2275 (algobank/known.json)
  [high] old: requests 2.31.0: PYSEC-2026-1872 (algobank/known.json)
  [high] old: requests 2.31.0: PYSEC-2026-1873 (algobank/known.json)
  [high] old: requests 2.31.0: PYSEC-2026-2275 (algobank/known.json)
  ...

# OPTIONS
algobank scope wheels/*.whl --json            # the same report for programs and agents
algobank scope wheels/*.whl --ignore-native   # report native binaries, but do not fail on them

# EXIT STATUS
# 0  no high finding
# 1  a high finding
# 2  error

title: Findings
body: Every finding is reported. None is suppressed because it is common or probably harmless.

high: a file that runs on every Python start (.pth, sitecustomize.py); a new power (network, process, environment, native code, TOP) and where it enters; new eval, exec or deserialization; a native binary (native binary detected. not checked); a new dependency; an sdist, whose build code is not analyzed; a known malicious or vulnerable release. The exit status is 1.
warning: a called package that was not algobanked in the same run. The exit status does not change.
medium, low, info: other new dynamic code, new entry points, changed dependency ranges, data files, and the scope each function uses.

title: Known Exploits and Vulnerabilities
body: Algobank ships the published advisories for the 1,000 most downloaded PyPI packages: malicious releases from OpenSSF (MAL-) and known vulnerabilities from PyPA (PYSEC-), unchanged, in known.json.
Algobank's own code decides on your machine whether a record applies: a listed version, or a version inside a range, compared by PEP 440 ordering. A match is a high finding that names the advisory.
Data as of 2026-10-27: 1,372 advisories. The newest copy is on the live branch; each release of Algobank ships the copy of its day.

title: Vision
body: Algobank is the bank of algorithms where codegens securely run the work of other codegens, vetted by codegens.
A codegen is anything that writes or runs code: AI coding agents, GitHub Actions and other CI runners, package managers and build systems, and human maintainers.
Algobank is an enclosure where humans and bots meet to check out each other's code.
